latest_release.body:
# Coopanion v0.2.23

**Gemini 的默认模型改为 gemini-4-hydrogen;对话页可以一键回到底部;World 设置页可以直接打开扩展详情**

## 新功能

- **Gemini 4 型号**:Gemini 的默认模型改为 `gemini-4-hydrogen`,推荐型号里加入 `gemini-4-argon`、`gemini-4-carbon`、`gemini-4-neon`。四个型号都按多模态处理(能看图、能听「投递录音」发去的录音),都有内置价目;`gemini-4-hydrogen` 和 `gemini-4-neon` 的思考强度可以到最高一档。已经建好的 Gemini 端点不会自动修改：想换成 Gemini 4,请修改端点的型号并打开多模态。新默认比原来的默认 `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` 贵：输入每百万 token 0.30 → 1.50 美元，输出 2.50 → 7.50 美元。
- **对话页「回到底部」**:在设置窗口的对话页往上翻看更早的消息后，输入框上方出现「↓ 回到底部」,点击回到最新的消息(感谢 @tokc2327-code)。
- **World 设置页直接打开扩展详情**:World 设置页的标题旁多了一个 ⓘ,点击打开这个扩展的详情;关闭后回到原来的页面，还没保存的设置仍在(感谢 @kwk1001、@AKIs-z01,#754)。

## 修复

- **开局引导里的过渡台词停留过久**:点完确认后的那句台词有时要停约 7 秒才收起。鼠标位置的回报中断一下之后，停在气泡位置的鼠标被当成了移入气泡;现在按正常的时长收起。
- **设置窗口里叠着两层弹窗时按 Esc**:只关闭最上面一层(感谢 @kwk1001)。

## 下载

- Windows x64 安装版:`Coopanion-Setup-0.2.23.exe`
- Windows x64 便携版:`Coopanion-0.2.23-win-x64-portable.zip`
- Windows on Arm 安装版:`Coopanion-Setup-0.2.23-arm64.exe`
- Windows on Arm 便携版:`Coopanion-0.2.23-win-arm64-portable.zip`
- Apple 芯片 Mac:`Coopanion-0.2.23-mac-arm64.dmg` / `.zip`
- Intel Mac:`Coopanion-0.2.23-mac-x64.dmg` / `.zip`
- Linux x64:`Coopanion-0.2.23-linux-x64.deb` / `.AppImage`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`:十个安装文件的 SHA-256 校验值。
- `latest.yml`、`latest-arm64.yml`、`latest-linux.yml`:自动更新读的版本信息，不用下载。

Windows x64 安装版、Windows on Arm 安装版和 AppImage 会自动更新到这个版本。macOS 版本仍是临时签名、未经 Apple 公证，第一次打开的方法见 README。除简体中文和英文外的译文由模型翻译，欢迎提 PR 修正。

English ｜ 简体中文

Website ｜ Install ｜ Getting Started ｜ Everyday Use ｜ Cost and Privacy ｜ FAQ ｜ Community ｜ Changelog ｜ Development

Coopanion is a desktop pet named Coo that lives on the bottom edge of your screen. It wanders along the edge, chats with you in speech bubbles and listens while you hold the talk key. If you let it, it can also look at your screen, click and type to use the computer for you. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. The interface comes in 11 languages: 简体中文, 繁體中文, English, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español (Latinoamérica), Português (Brasil), Italiano and Русский. On first start it follows the system language, falling back to English, and you can change it later under **Language** on the Habits page. Coo talks to you in the same language. Translations other than Simplified Chinese and English are machine-made; PRs that fix them are welcome.

## Features - Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, Zhipu GLM, Doubao, Baidu Qianfan and StepFun: pick one and paste an API key. You can also sign in with a ChatGPT account and use its ChatGPT plan. - Hold the talk key and speak, or type. Coo answers in a bubble. Speech is recognized on your machine by default, or by a transcription service you set up. - Coo remembers you. What it knows about you is written to `PARTNER.md`, and longer memories are organized by topic and date. When Git is available, every change Coo makes to its text keeps a history; Windows ships with Git, macOS and Linux use the one installed on the system. - With your permission, Coo can look at the screen, click, type and switch windows. This is off by default and you decide when it asks first. It pauses as soon as you touch the mouse or keyboard, and talking with the talk key interrupts it. - An icon over Coo's head shows when it is thinking, reading files, searching, writing or using the computer. - Pick Coo or **DeepSeek Chan**, an animated whale girl with eight vendor color schemes and three outfits. Other figure packs are imported on the Dress up page; see the [figure pack compatibility promise](packages/cortico-world-desktop-pet/README.md#形象包兼容承诺). - Coo comes in several colors, including Nai Coo and five Cultist Simulator principles, and can wear a hat, animal ears or a halo, headphones, an earring or a bow, glasses and neckwear. The size of the pet, its bubbles and the text can each be adjusted. - Ask Coo to remind you at a time of day or in a few minutes, and it sets an alarm. - Install Worlds such as a QQ bot, a drawing room and small games from **World extensions → Extension market**. - Export Coo and its bubbles as an OBS Browser source with a transparent background, to put it on a stream. What changed in each version is in [Releases](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases). ## Install You need: - Windows 10 or 11 (x64), Windows 11 (Arm64), macOS 13 or later (Apple silicon or Intel), or a 64-bit Linux desktop (X11; in a Wayland session it runs through XWayland, with the limits under [Linux](#linux); speech recognition needs glibc 2.32 or later, which means Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12 or newer); - an API key from one model service, billed by usage (see [Cost and privacy](#cost-and-privacy)), or a ChatGPT account with a plan. Every release page has a `SHA256SUMS.txt` for checking the downloads. ### Windows - **Installer**: download `Coopanion-Setup-.exe` from the [latest release](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest) and run it; on a PC with an Arm processor, download `Coopanion-Setup--arm64.exe`. The installer is not code-signed, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info** → **Run anyway**. It installs to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Coopanion` by default, and the program and its data both live in that folder. Don't install it into Program Files or another folder that needs administrator rights: Coopanion can't write its data there and quits with an error. There is no Start menu entry; open it from the desktop icon. - **One command**: in PowerShell, run ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/main/installer/install.ps1 | iex ``` The script downloads the installer for your processor. If antivirus software blocks the graphical installer, the script keeps the downloaded installer and prints its path. Run the downloaded installer with `/S` for a silent install, or add Coopanion to your antivirus's allowed list and try again. - **Portable**: download `Coopanion--win-x64-portable.zip` (`…-win-arm64-portable.zip` for an Arm processor) from the [latest release](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest), unpack it anywhere and run `Coopanion.exe`. Its data is kept in the folder's `data`. Copy the whole folder and you have a second Coo with its own memory and settings; up to 5 can run at once, installed and portable together. The portable version does not update itself: unpack the new version into a new folder and copy the old `data` over. ### macOS 1. From the [latest release](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest), download `Coopanion--mac-arm64.dmg` (Apple silicon) or `…-mac-x64.dmg` (Intel), open it and drag Coopanion into Applications. 2. The app is neither signed with an Apple developer ID nor notarized, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open it once and click **Done** on the warning, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security, click **Open Anyway** and enter your password. 3. Coopanion's icon is in the menu bar. It shows up in the Dock only while the settings window is open. While the App Store is in front, Coo drops behind other windows so it doesn't cover the Touch ID prompt for purchases. > [!NOTE] > macOS asks for Microphone (voice input), Input Monitoring (talk key), Screen & System Audio Recording and Accessibility (computer use) the first time each one is needed, and switching apps during computer use also asks to control "System Events". Restart Coopanion after changing Screen Recording, Input Monitoring or Accessibility. macOS does not carry these permissions over to an updated version: if a switch is on but Coopanion says the permission is missing, remove Coopanion from that list with −, add `/Applications/Coopanion.app` back and restart. ### Linux 1. From the [latest release](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest), download `Coopanion--linux-x64.deb` (Debian / Ubuntu) or `Coopanion--linux-x64.AppImage` (other distributions). 2. deb: `sudo apt install ./Coopanion--linux-x64.deb`. AppImage: install your distribution's FUSE 2 compatibility library, run `chmod +x Coopanion-*.AppImage`, then start it. > [!NOTE] > The pet is a transparent always-on-top window, so the desktop needs compositing (on by default in GNOME and KDE). The tray icon needs status icon support (GNOME needs the AppIndicator extension); without a tray you can still right-click Coo to open the settings. Computer use needs `xdotool` and `zenity`, which the deb pulls in; under Wayland, screenshots also need one of `grim`, `spectacle`, `scrot` or ImageMagick. > > In a Wayland session Coopanion runs through XWayland, which sees the cursor only over X11 windows. While the cursor is over the desktop or a native Wayland window, Coo's eyes do not follow it, and the hover buttons show only once the cursor moves onto Coo. ## Getting started 1. **Start**: Coo drops to the bottom of the screen and an icon appears in the tray (the menu bar on Mac, the status bar on Linux). No window opens. 2. **Follow the guide**: in its bubbles, Coo asks for the interface language, where you heard about it (you can skip this), what it should call you, what Coo is like, how often it walks around, which touches it should answer and which model service to use. Then it downloads the speech model: FunASR, about 230 MB, or Whisper, about 360 MB, when the interface language is French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian or Russian. The download comes from ModelScope and falls back to Hugging Face. **Back** at the top left of the bubble returns to the step before, with your earlier answer in place. The × ends the guide, and **Guide** on the Start page runs it again. To change Coo's personality or the way it talks afterwards, just tell it; it writes the persona into its prompt itself. 3. **Say hello**: tap **Left Alt** (**Left Option** on Mac), then press and hold it, say "hello", and let go to send. Allow microphone access when asked.
Connect a model: API key or ChatGPT sign-in Choose a service in Coo's bubble or on the Start page, create an API key on its platform (DeepSeek also needs a topped-up balance) and paste it in. | We have only tested DeepSeek, Anthropic and StepFun Step Plan with real keys, so please open an issue if another one fails. **ChatGPT** needs no key: choose it, press **Continue with ChatGPT** and sign in in the browser that opens. Coo then uses that account's ChatGPT plan. When the plan's usage limit is reached, Coo goes quiet and tries again every 5 minutes.
## Everyday use ### Talking and playing - **Talk**: tap **Left Alt** (**Left Option** on Mac), then hold it and speak; let go to send. The talk key, microphone, speech threshold and listening mode (**While the talk key is held**, **The talk key switches it on and off**, **All the time**) are on the Voice input page. With the system default microphone selected, Coo switches along when you change the system's default input device. If the chosen microphone is unplugged or can't be found, Coo listens through the system default input and switches back when it returns. Voice input uses echo cancellation and noise suppression but not automatic gain control, so Coo leaves the system's microphone volume alone; if your voice comes through too quiet, raise the input volume in the system settings. - **Type**: hover over Coo and click the bubble button next to it, or type on the Chat page. Turn on **Habits → Typing key** to open the typing box from any window (double-press Left Ctrl by default). A message can carry up to four pasted images from the typing box, or eight from the Chat page. - **Chat page**: after you scroll up to earlier messages, **↓ Back to bottom** appears above the input; click it to return to the latest message. - **Changing keys**: the talk key and the typing key can each be another key, a key combination or a mouse side button, pressed one to three times. When both use the same key, a quick double tap opens the typing box; holding the last press for more than 300 ms starts listening instead and does not open the box. What you say during those 300 ms is kept; with **Open the microphone only while held** on, the microphone opens only at that point, so wait for the listening bubble before speaking. - **Bubbles**: move the pointer into an open bubble to keep it open until the pointer leaves. Click what Coo is saying to skip the rest of that line. Coo plays a chime when it asks you to confirm something, such as using your computer; clear **Alerts** under **Habits → Sounds** to silence it. Activity bubbles, input bubbles, bubble and text size, and how fast the text appears are on the Habits page. So is how long speech and input bubbles stay: **Auto**, or **Fixed** at 1–60 seconds, counted from when a speech bubble has typed out or an input bubble was sent or recognized; a question or guide card waiting behind a speech bubble ends a fixed hold at the Auto time. - **Alarms**: the alarms Coo has set are listed under **Alarms** on the App notifications page, where you can delete them; Coo is told when you do. Daily alarms keep ringing at the same local time across daylight-saving changes. Alarms missed while the app was closed go off the next time it starts. - **Holidays**: on Christmas Day and on January 1, 2027, Coo learns it is a holiday when it first appears on your desktop that day, or at midnight if it is already there. When it learns of the New Year, Coo can light fireworks behind itself that spell out 2027, once. - **Touch**: click to poke Coo, rub back and forth over its head to pat it, or drag to pick it up. Let go mid-swing to throw it; drop it on another display and it stays there. **Habits → Response mode** decides which touches Coo answers right away. Speech is recognized locally by default: FunASR for Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean, Whisper for French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Russian, and on Windows you can also use the system recognizer. You can switch to an **OpenAI-compatible** transcription service on the Voice input page instead; each sentence you say is then sent to that service as audio. When the current model takes audio (a Gemini-protocol endpoint with multimodal input on, for example), each batch of speech goes to the model with its recording along with the recognized text. On the Voice input page you can turn off **Send the recording**, or turn off **Send the transcript** to send the recording alone; a batch whose recording is longer than **Recording limit** (5 minutes by default) is sent as text only. With a model that does not take audio, only the text is sent. Rest the pointer on Coo and the buttons you picked pop up beside it: up to 6 of typing, voice input, walking, night mode, sounds, hide, size, dress up and My Worlds (picked in the first-run introduction, changed later under **Habits**). Right-clicking Coo shows the same ones, plus settings, pause / resume and quit. Hovering the dress button shows your favourite looks in a row over Coo's head; scroll or click to switch. A **Size** hover button can be added too: hovering it shows a size slider over Coo's head; drag it, or scroll over the button. Clicking **Size** keeps the slider open until you click it again or click elsewhere. While the size or the look changes, the button under the pointer stays put and moves back beside Coo once the pointer leaves. Closing the settings window does not quit the app. The tray menu (the menu bar icon on Mac) has **Show pet** or **Hide pet**, **Let clicks pass through Coo**, **Restart** and **Quit**; **Start at login** is under **Habits → General**. With click-through on, every click goes through Coo to the window below while Coo keeps walking and talking, which helps while gaming. It only lasts for the current run: choose **Stop clicks passing through Coo** or quit to turn it off. ### Appearance and sound Change the figure, colors and accessories on the **Dress up** page, including the accessories' main and accent colors; changes apply right away. Figure packs can be imported from a zip or a folder, or dragged onto the page, and imported packs are uninstalled there too. Import, replacement and uninstall confirmations, progress and errors use the settings window’s shared dialogs. **Size**, under the figures, sets how large Coo is on the desktop; each figure keeps its own size and gets it back when you switch to it again. The previews on **Dress up** and **Start** keep one size. The star at the top right of the preview adds the look Coo wears to **Favourite looks**, listed in one row at the top of the page: click one to put it on, drag it to reorder, or rename and delete it. A favourite keeps the size it was saved at and puts it back on with the look; its picture is drawn at that size, with the percentage in its corner. After you pick a favourite and change it, its size included, a save button next to the star writes the change back to it. You can also just ask Coo to change its look. By default it changes its figure, colors, walking and snoring on its own, and asks you first before changing sizes, sounds, night mode or names; **Habits → Self-adjustment** loosens or tightens this. Asked what it looks like right now, Coo can take a picture of its body as it is on the desktop at that moment, without bubbles or the desktop behind it; while the pet is hidden there is none to take.

Under **Habits → Sounds** you can choose which sounds play, set the volume for all of the pet's sounds, and let the sound pan left or right with Coo's position on the screen. **Speech → Read bubbles aloud** makes Coo babble short syllables as the text appears, instead of the usual talking sound; pitch and speed are adjustable. These settings only cover the pet's own sounds. Sounds from other Worlds are set on their own pages.

To show Coo in OBS, turn on **Habits → Other → Export OBS overlay**, add the URL it shows as an OBS Browser source and set the width and height to your screen resolution. The source contains only Coo and its bubbles, on a transparent background. ### Computer use Computer use is off by default. Turn on **Let Coo use this computer** under **Habits → Computer use** and confirm the risk notice. If you only want Coo to see the screen and keep its hands off the mouse and keyboard, turn off **Allow the mouse and keyboard**. There are four settings for when Coo asks you first: | When to ask you | When Coo asks | | --- | --- | | Every turn | Before the first screenshot or mouse/keyboard action in each turn | | Before acting | Screenshots without asking; before the first mouse or keyboard action in each turn | | Once (default) | Screenshots without asking; once before acting, then not again for the consent period (30 minutes by default) | | Never | Never | - Coo asks in a bubble, or in a system dialog while the pet is hidden. - Before typing into a terminal or pressing Win+R, Coo asks separately, and that consent also lasts for the consent period. To skip this question, turn it off in advanced mode under **Desktop pet → Config**. - Only what you say, type or choose on the desktop pet's side can make Coo act. When another World asks it to use the computer, Coo checks with you in a bubble first. - Coo can hold keys down for up to 30 seconds, without pausing for your mouse or keyboard meanwhile, and keep a mouse button down across several steps. Whatever it still holds down is released when its turn ends. - As soon as you move the mouse or use the keyboard, Coo pauses and waits until you have been idle for two seconds (by default); if you keep going for 15 seconds, it gives up on that step. It also holds off while you are typing to it. - Anything you say with the talk key interrupts Coo once it is transcribed: the reply being written and the steps not yet started are dropped, while a click, drag or key sequence already under way finishes first and a held key is released at once. When it listens **All the time**, what Coo hears does not interrupt it. Pressing the talk key stops **Read bubbles aloud** at once, and lines that appear before you let go stay silent. - Do logins, passwords and payments yourself. One wake allows 40 model requests by default; when Coo hits that limit it stops, and you can tell it to keep going. The limit is **Requests per wake-up** in advanced mode. ### Settings window Open the settings window from the tray icon or from Coo's right-click menu. | Page | What's there | | --- | --- | | Start | Model connection, showing or hiding the pet, interface colors, the first-run guide | | Habits | Language and names, automatic updates, usage statistics, walking and touch responses, which settings Coo may change itself, shortcuts, display, sound, computer use, OBS overlay | | Dress up | Figure, colors and accessories; import or uninstall figure packs | | Voice input | Recognition engine or transcription service, model download, talk key, microphone, listening mode, speech threshold | | System prompt | Persona and prompt templates; Ctrl+S saves, and **Apply now** puts the new prompt into the current conversation | | Usage & cost | Token usage and spending by day and model | | Chat | Conversation history, typing, images | | World extensions | Installed Worlds, groups and order, the extension market | Pause / resume and the switch to **Advanced mode** are at the bottom of the sidebar. Advanced mode adds the **Model connections**, Persona, Memory, **Console** and **Diagnostics** pages. Model connections is where you change models, adjust reasoning effort, add other compatible services, enter prices for services without built-in ones and install provider extensions. Settings show operation errors beside the initiating control. If that control is no longer visible, the error uses a bottom notification. Read failures stay in the affected content region; refresh failures preserve loaded data and edits until a successful retry. Diagnostics report connection, event and log failures separately. Saving an avatar or name, pausing Coo and cancelling an alarm use the updated state as confirmation. ### World extensions In **World extensions → Extension market** you can search for Worlds, filter by category or tag, and install one with **Add to My Worlds** on its card, or open its details first. Packages in the [official index](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/cortico-extensions) also show tags, votes and comments; commenting needs a GitHub sign-in. Caution tags can be excluded; packages with an excluded tag stay out of the results, and the exclusion is remembered next time. A newly installed extension shows up under **Applies on restart**; click **Restart process** to load it. In **My Worlds** you can: - group Worlds and drag them into order, and the sidebar follows the same order; - click a World's name or avatar to see its details and open its configuration; - hide a World from the sidebar, keep it running but hide its tools and messages from Coo, or stop, restart or delete it. On a World's settings page, click the circled **i** beside its title to open the extension details. A running World can't be deleted; stop it first. A deleted World stays under **Applies on restart**, marked in red, until you restart the process.

Provider extensions are under **Advanced mode → Model connections → Extension market**; one that a connection still uses can't be deleted until you delete that connection. Installed extensions live in the data folder and survive a reinstall of the app. If you quit the app while an extension is being installed or uninstalled, it waits for that install or uninstall to finish before quitting. ### Updates The Windows installer build and the AppImage download new versions in the background, and Coo asks whether to restart and update when one is ready. Choose **Later** and it installs when you quit. To stop automatic updates, turn off **Habits → General → Automatic updates**: Coopanion then stops checking and downloading, and an update that was already downloaded is not installed. The Mac version, the deb and the Windows portable version do not update themselves. When a new version is out, a download link appears in the settings window's title bar; download it and install it yourself. ## Cost and privacy - **Cost**: Coopanion is free. The model service you choose bills you for usage, which you can see on the Usage & cost page. DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini's paid tier and xAI have built-in prices, and amounts can be shown in another currency at the current exchange rate (or a built-in rate when it can't be fetched). When you sign in with ChatGPT, usage counts toward the plan and no cost is shown. - **Sent to the model service**: what you say and type, attached images, how you interact with Coo, and screenshots during computer use. Only the service you configured receives them. - **Kept on your computer**: API keys and the ChatGPT sign-in, memory, conversation history, settings and logs. Speech is recognized locally; when the current model takes audio, each batch's recording also goes to the model service and is kept in the data folder on your computer, which you can turn off on the Voice input page. If you choose a transcription service on the Voice input page, each sentence's recording goes to that service. - **Anonymous usage statistics**: sent to `survey.palailab.org`. They contain the app version, an outline of the system and hardware, which model service and model you use, which extensions are installed, how often and how long you use the app, settings, where in the program a crash happened, and a randomly generated install ID; no conversations, screenshots, keys, error messages or files. Every field is listed in [docs/TELEMETRY.md](docs/TELEMETRY.md). Turn them off under **Habits → General → Usage statistics**. - **Other network access**: checking GitHub for new versions (the Windows installer build and the AppImage check at start and every 6 hours while automatic updates are on; the other builds check when the settings window opens); npm and the official extension index on GitHub for the extension market, and GitHub for votes and comments; ModelScope, falling back to Hugging Face, when downloading the speech model. ## Data and uninstalling | System | Data folder | Uninstall | | --- | --- | --- | | Windows | `data` in the install folder; for the portable version, `data` in its folder | Settings → Apps; for the portable version, turn off **Start at login** under **Habits → General**, then delete the folder | | macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/Coopanion` | Drag Coopanion from Applications to the Trash | | Linux | `~/.config/Coopanion` | deb: `sudo apt remove coopanion`; AppImage: delete the file | Uninstalling the installed version keeps your data. The portable version keeps `data` inside its own folder, so back it up before deleting the folder. To remove everything, delete the data folder by hand; on Windows, delete the whole install folder and also `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Coopanion`, which records where the data is. Inside it, `home` holds memory, conversation history, settings and API keys, `home/models` the speech model, `extensions` the extensions and `logs` the logs. On Windows, after reinstalling into a new folder, the first start asks whether to keep using your earlier data or start a new Coo. ## FAQ
The pet is gone Right-click the tray icon and choose **Show pet**; if the tray icon is hidden, click `^` at the bottom right of the taskbar first. Opening the program again works too. On Mac, click the menu bar icon and choose **Show pet**.
Clicks go straight through Coo **Let clicks pass through Coo** is on in the tray menu. Click it again to turn it off, or restart Coopanion.
Coo does not answer Check **Start → Connected model** and the run status at the bottom of the sidebar. If it says **Paused**, click resume. If it says **Not connected**, make sure the API key was pasted in full and the account has credit, then click **Save and start**; for an existing connection, **Test** checks it again. Keys for Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax and Zhipu GLM only work on the platform (mainland China or international) where they were created, and Doubao needs the default model enabled in the Ark console. After 5 failed model requests in a row, Coo tells you what went wrong in a bubble. For a rejected key or an unknown model name it offers a button that opens the settings; for rate limits and server errors it asks you to wait a while.
Coo cannot hear me - The mic button next to Coo should not be crossed out. - Tap Left Alt first, then press and hold it (two presses too far apart don't count). - The Voice input page should show the recognizer as ready (click **Download** if the model is missing), and its level meter should move while you speak. - Windows: in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone, allow desktop apps to use the microphone. - Mac: in System Settings → Privacy & Security, turn on Microphone and Input Monitoring for Coopanion, then restart it.
I need a proxy Coopanion uses the system proxy (HTTP or HTTPS; SOCKS proxies are not used) as it is set at the moment of each request, so turning a proxy app on or off needs no restart, and a PAC script picks the proxy per site. If `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` are set in the environment Coopanion starts from, those take precedence. Local traffic inside the app skips the proxy.
On Linux, Coo leaves square trails behind it With Intel graphics (Mesa's iris driver), fast clear leaves old frames in transparent windows. Start Coopanion with `INTEL_DEBUG=nofc` set to turn it off, for example `INTEL_DEBUG=nofc coopanion` for the deb; rendering on a discrete GPU also fixes it.
The whole screen under the pet turns black On some Windows machines, transparent windows are drawn black while hardware acceleration is on. Try adding ` --disable-gpu-compositing` to the end of the shortcut's Target field.
What is it thinking? The Chat page has the full record. If something goes wrong, switch to advanced mode, click **Export diagnostics** on the Diagnostics page and attach the file to an [issue](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/issues).

Coopanion 是一只住在屏幕底边的桌宠，名叫 Coo。它在底边走来走去，用气泡跟你聊天，按住说话键它就能听你说话；你同意的话，它还能看屏幕、点鼠标、敲键盘，帮你操作电脑。Windows、macOS 和 Linux 都能用。 界面有简体中文、繁體中文、English、日本語、한국어、Français、Deutsch、Español (Latinoamérica)、Português (Brasil)、Italiano、Русский 11 种语言。第一次启动时跟随系统语言，系统语言不在其中就用英文，之后可以在「习惯」页的「语言」里改。Coo 也用界面语言跟你说话。除简体中文和英文外，译文由模型翻译，发现不通顺的地方欢迎提 PR。

## 功能 - 支持 DeepSeek、通义千问、Kimi、智谱 GLM、豆包、MiniMax、阶跃星辰、百度千帆、OpenRouter、OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、xAI，选一家，贴上 API Key 就能用。也可以登录 ChatGPT 账号，用你的 ChatGPT 套餐。 - 按住说话键说话，或者打字，Coo 在气泡里回你。语音默认在本机识别，也可以交给你配置的转写服务。 - Coo 会记住你。它对你的了解写在 `PARTNER.md`，更长的记忆按主题和日期整理。电脑上有 Git 时，Coo 改过的文字都留有历史版本；Windows 版自带 Git，macOS 和 Linux 用系统里装的 Git。 - 你允许后，Coo 可以看屏幕、点击、打字、切换窗口。这个功能默认关着，什么时候问你可以自己定；你一动鼠标或键盘它就先停手，按说话键开口能直接打断它。 - Coo 在想事情、看文件、搜索、写东西或操作电脑时，头顶会冒出对应的小图标。 - 形象可以选 Coo，或者 **DeepSeek 大肥鱼**（会动的鲸鱼娘，八套厂商配色，三套衣服）；别的形象包在「装扮」页导入，见[形象包兼容承诺](packages/cortico-world-desktop-pet/README.md#形象包兼容承诺)。 - Coo 有奶Coo、灯、杯、铸、心、冬等配色，头顶可以戴帽子、兽耳或光环，耳侧可以挂耳机、耳环或蝴蝶结，还有眼镜和颈饰。桌宠、气泡和字的大小分开调。 - 跟 Coo 说几点或者几分钟后提醒你，它会定好闹钟。 - 在「World 扩展 → 扩展市场」装 World，比如 QQ 机器人、画室和小游戏。 - 可以把 Coo 和气泡导出成 OBS 的「浏览器」来源，背景透明，直播时能叠在画面上。 每个版本改了什么，见 [Releases](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases)。 ## 安装 你需要： - Windows 10 或 11（x64）、Windows 11（Arm64）、macOS 13 及以上（Apple 芯片和 Intel 都行），或者 64 位 Linux 桌面（X11；Wayland 会话里经 XWayland 运行，有[Linux](#linux)一节写的限制；语音识别要 glibc 2.32 及以上，也就是 Ubuntu 22.04、Debian 12 及更新的版本）； - 一家模型服务的 API Key，按用量付费（见[费用与隐私](#费用与隐私)），或者一个开了套餐的 ChatGPT 账号。 每个版本的发布页都附有 `SHA256SUMS.txt`，可以用来核对下载的文件。 ### Windows - **安装包**：从[最新发布](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest)下载 `Coopanion-Setup-版本号.exe` 并运行；Arm 处理器的电脑下载 `Coopanion-Setup-版本号-arm64.exe`。安装包没有数字签名，Windows 可能提示「Windows 已保护你的电脑」，点「更多信息」→「仍要运行」。默认装在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Coopanion`，程序和数据都在这个目录里。别装进 Program Files 这类要管理员权限的目录，Coopanion 在那里写不了数据，会提示后退出。开始菜单里没有它，从桌面图标打开。 - **一行命令**：在 PowerShell 里运行 ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/main/installer/install.ps1 | iex ``` 脚本按处理器下载对应的安装包。如果杀毒软件拦下了图形界面的安装，脚本会保留下载好的安装包并打印路径。可以用已下载的安装包加 `/S` 静默安装，或者先把 Coopanion 加进杀毒软件的白名单再装。 - **便携版**：从[最新发布](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest)下载 `Coopanion-版本号-win-x64-portable.zip`（Arm 处理器下载 `…-win-arm64-portable.zip`），解压到任意文件夹，运行 `Coopanion.exe`。数据放在这个文件夹的 `data` 里。整个文件夹复制一份就是另一只 Coo，记忆和设置互不影响；安装版和便携版加起来最多同时开 5 只。便携版不会自动更新，升级时把新版解压到新文件夹，再把旧的 `data` 拷过去。 ### macOS 1. 从[最新发布](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest)下载 `Coopanion-版本号-mac-arm64.dmg`（Apple 芯片）或 `…-mac-x64.dmg`（Intel），打开后把 Coopanion 拖进「应用程序」。 2. 应用没有 Apple 开发者签名，也没有经过公证，第一次打开会被拦下。先打开一次，在提示里点「完成」，再到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」点「仍要打开」，输入密码确认。 3. Coopanion 的图标在屏幕顶部的菜单栏里，只有打开设置窗口时才会出现在程序坞。 App Store 在前台时，Coo 会退到其他窗口后面，免得挡住购买时的触控 ID 确认。 > [!NOTE] > 第一次用到时，macOS 会分别询问麦克风（语音输入）、输入监控（说话键）、录屏与系统录音和辅助功能（操作电脑）的权限；操作电脑时切换应用，还会请求控制「System Events」。录屏、输入监控和辅助功能改完要重启 Coopanion。更新后 macOS 不会把这些授权沿用到新版本：如果开关开着却提示没有权限，用「−」把 Coopanion 从那个列表里移除，再把 `/Applications/Coopanion.app` 加回来，然后重启。 ### Linux 1. 从[最新发布](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest)下载 `Coopanion-版本号-linux-x64.deb`（Debian / Ubuntu）或 `Coopanion-版本号-linux-x64.AppImage`（其他发行版）。 2. deb：`sudo apt install ./Coopanion-版本号-linux-x64.deb`。AppImage：先装好发行版提供的 FUSE 2 兼容库，执行 `chmod +x Coopanion-*.AppImage`，再运行它。 > [!NOTE] > 桌宠是一个透明的置顶窗口，桌面要开着窗口合成（GNOME 和 KDE 默认开着）。托盘图标要桌面支持状态栏图标（GNOME 需要装 AppIndicator 扩展）；没有托盘也能右键 Coo 打开设置。操作电脑要用到 `xdotool` 和 `zenity`，deb 会自动装上；Wayland 下截屏还需要 `grim`、`spectacle`、`scrot` 或 ImageMagick 中的一个。 > > Wayland 会话里 Coopanion 经 XWayland 运行，XWayland 只在光标停在 X11 窗口上时知道光标在哪。光标在桌面或原生 Wayland 窗口上时，Coo 的眼睛不跟着它转；悬停按钮要等光标移到 Coo 身上才出现。 ## 快速上手 1. **启动**：Coo 落到屏幕底边，任务栏（Mac 上是菜单栏，Linux 上是状态栏）多出一个图标，不会弹出窗口。 2. **跟着引导设置**：Coo 会在气泡里问你界面语言、从哪里知道它的（可以跳过）、希望它怎么称呼你、Coo 是什么性子、多久走动一次、哪些互动要回应、用哪家模型服务，最后下载语音识别模型：FunASR 约 230 MB；界面语言是法、德、西、葡、意、俄语时下载 Whisper，约 360 MB。模型从 ModelScope 下载，下不了时改用 Hugging Face。点气泡左上角的「上一步」回到前一步，之前的回答还在；点 × 可以结束引导，以后在「开始」页点「使用向导」重来。想调整它的性格和说话方式，引导结束后直接跟它说，它会自己把人设写进提示词。 3. **说第一句话**：快速按一下**左 Alt**（Mac 上是**左 Option**），紧接着按住，说「你好」，松开就发出去了。系统询问麦克风权限时选允许。

## 日常使用 ### 说话与互动 - **说话**：快速按一下**左 Alt**（Mac 上是**左 Option**），紧接着按住说话，松开发送。说话键、麦克风、说话门槛和收音方式（按住说话键时收音、用说话键切换收音、持续收音）在「语音输入」页改。麦克风选系统默认时，你换了系统的默认输入设备，Coo 也跟着换。所选的麦克风拔掉或找不到时，Coo 改用系统默认输入设备，插回后再换回来。收音开着回声消除和降噪，不开自动增益，Coo 不会改动系统的麦克风音量；声音太小时，在系统设置里调高输入音量。 - **打字**：鼠标移到 Coo 身上，点旁边的气泡按钮；也可以在「对话」页里打字。打开「习惯 → 打字键」后，在任何窗口都能叫出打字框（默认双击左 Ctrl）。打字框一条消息最多贴 4 张图，「对话」页最多 8 张。 - **对话页**：往上翻到更早的消息后，输入框上方出现「↓ 回到底部」，点一下回到最新的消息。 - **换键**：说话键和打字键都可以改成别的键、组合键或鼠标侧键，按一到三下触发。两个设成同一个键时，快速双击打开打字框；最后一下按住超过 300 毫秒才开始收音，这时不会打开打字框。这 300 毫秒里说的话也会收进去；开了「按住时才打开麦克风」时，麦克风要到这时才打开，请等倾听气泡出现再说话。 - **气泡**：把鼠标移进已显示的气泡，气泡会停留到鼠标移开。点一下 Coo 说的话，这句话剩下的部分就跳过。Coo 请你确认时（比如操作电脑之前）会响一声提醒，在「习惯 → 音效」里取消勾选「提醒」就不再响。状态气泡、输入气泡、气泡和字的大小、出字速度在「习惯」页调。台词和输入气泡停留多久也在那里设置：「自动」，或「固定」1–60 秒，台词气泡从出完字、输入气泡从发出或识别完成时开始计时；台词后面排着提问或引导时，固定档按自动档的时长收起。 - **闹钟**：定好的闹钟在「应用通知」页的「闹钟」里能看到，也能删掉，删了 Coo 会知道。每天的闹钟遇到夏令时切换，仍按原来的当地时间响。应用关着时错过的闹钟，下次启动会补上。 - **节日**：圣诞节和 2027 年元旦当天，Coo 第一次出现在桌面上时会知道今天过节；Coo 已经在桌面上的话，零点时知道。知道是元旦时，Coo 可以在身后放一次写着「2027」的烟花。 - **互动**：点一下是戳它，在它头上来回划是摸头，按住拖动是把它拎起来。拖到一半松手能把它甩出去，拎到另一块屏幕上松手，它就留在那块屏幕上。哪些互动它会马上回应，在「习惯 → 回应模式」里选。 语音默认在本机识别：中、英、日、韩语用 FunASR，法、德、西、葡、意、俄语用 Whisper，Windows 上还可以用系统自带的识别。也可以在「语音输入」页改用 **OpenAI 兼容**的转写服务，这时每句录音都会发给那个服务。 当前的模型支持音频输入时（例如开了多模态的 Gemini 协议端点），每批语音的录音会和识别出的文字一起发送给模型。「语音输入」页可以关闭「投递录音」，也可以关闭「投递转写」只发送录音；一批语音的录音超过「录音上限」（默认 5 分钟）时只发送文字。模型不支持音频输入时只发送文字。 鼠标停在 Coo 身上，旁边会冒出几个按钮：打字、语音输入、走动、夜间模式、音效、隐藏、大小、装扮和「我的 World」里，你选的那几个（最多 6 个，开局引导里选，之后在「习惯」里改）。右键 Coo 也是这几个，再加上设置、暂停 / 继续和退出。鼠标停在装扮按钮上，头顶会出现一排收藏的形象，滚轮或点击切换。悬停按钮里可以加上「大小」：鼠标停在它上面，头顶出现大小滑条，拖动或在按钮上滚动滚轮调整；点一下「大小」把滑条钉住，再点一次或点别处收起。调大小、换形象时，鼠标指着的按钮不跟着桌宠移动，移开后再回到桌宠旁边。关掉设置窗口不会退出应用。托盘菜单（Mac 上是菜单栏图标）里有「显示桌宠」或「隐藏桌宠」、「启用鼠标穿透」、「重新启动」和「退出」；开机启动在「习惯 → 通用」里。启用鼠标穿透后，点击都会穿过 Coo 落到下面的窗口，它照常走动和说话，玩游戏时比较方便；这个开关只在本次运行有效，点「停用鼠标穿透」或退出应用就恢复。 ### 装扮与声音 在「装扮」页换形象、配色和配件，配件的主色和点缀色也能调，改了马上生效。形象包可以从 zip 或文件夹导入，也可以直接拖到页面上；导入的形象包也在这里卸载。导入、替换和卸载的确认、进度与错误统一显示在设置窗口弹窗中。形象下面的「大小」调整 Coo 在桌面上的大小；每个形象分别记住自己的大小，换回这个形象时恢复。「装扮」和「开始」页预览里的大小不变。 点预览右上角的星形按钮，把当前形象加到「已收藏的形象」，它们排成一行列在页面最上方：点一下换上，拖动调整顺序，也能重命名和删除。收藏会连同当时的大小一起保存，换上时也换回这个大小；收藏的缩略图按大小显示，角上标着百分比。选中一个收藏并做了改动（包括大小）后，星形按钮旁会出现保存按钮，把改动存回它。 也可以直接让 Coo 给自己换。默认它能自己改形象、配色、走动和打呼，改大小、音效、夜间模式、称呼这些会先问你；放宽或收紧在「习惯 → 自主配置权限」里调。问起 Coo 现在的样子时，Coo 能取一张那一刻桌面上的身体图片来回答，图里没有气泡和桌面；隐藏桌宠后取不到。

在「习惯 → 音效」里可以选要响的声音、调桌宠所有声音的音量，还可以让声音跟着 Coo 在屏幕上的位置偏左或偏右。打开「说话声 → 念出气泡文字」后，Coo 出字时会念出一串短音节，代替原来的说话音效，音高和语速都能调。这些设置只管桌宠的声音，其他 World 的声音在它们自己的页面里设置。

想在 OBS 里放 Coo：打开「习惯 → 其他 → 导出 OBS 画面」，把显示的地址加成 OBS 的「浏览器」来源，宽高填屏幕分辨率。画面里只有 Coo 和气泡，背景透明。 ### 让 Coo 操作电脑 这个功能默认关着。在「习惯 → 电脑操作」打开「让 Coo 操作这台电脑」，看完风险说明后确认。只想让它看屏幕、不碰鼠标键盘，就关掉「允许操作鼠标和键盘」。 什么时候问你，有四档可选： | 询问时机 | 什么时候问 | | --- | --- | | 每轮询问 | 每一轮第一次看屏幕或动鼠标键盘之前 | | 操作前询问 | 看屏幕不问；每一轮第一次动鼠标键盘之前问 | | 询问一次（默认） | 看屏幕不问；动手前问一次，同意后在有效期内不再问，有效期默认 30 分钟 | | 从不询问 | 都不问 | - 平时在气泡里问你，桌宠隐藏时改用系统对话框。 - Coo 在终端里打字或按 Win+R 之前，会另外问你一次，同意后同样在有效期内不再问。不想被问，可以在高级模式的「桌宠 → 配置」里关掉。 - 只有你在桌宠这边说的话、打的字和选的选项能让 Coo 动手。其他 World 发来的操作请求，它会先在气泡里问你。 - Coo 能按住键盘上的键最多 30 秒，按住期间不会因为你动鼠标键盘而停下；也能在几步之间一直按着鼠标键。这一轮结束时，它还按着的键都会松开。 - 你一动鼠标或键盘，Coo 就先停下，等你停手两秒（默认）再继续；你一直在用、等满 15 秒，它就放弃这一步。你给它打字时，它也会先等你打完。 - 用说话键说的话转写完就会打断 Coo：正在生成的回复和还没做的步骤都会停下，已经开始的点击、拖拽或一串按键会做完再停，按住的键会马上松开。收音方式是「持续收音」时，听到的话不会打断它。按下说话键时「念出气泡文字」的声音马上停止，松开之前出现的台词也不出声。 - 登录、输密码、付款这些步骤请自己来。一次唤醒默认最多请求模型 40 次，到上限它会停下，想继续就再跟它说一声；上限可以在高级模式里改「单次唤醒上限」。 ### 设置窗口 点托盘图标，或者右键 Coo 选设置，就能打开设置窗口。 | 页面 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | 开始 | 连接模型、显示或隐藏桌宠、界面配色、重新走一遍引导 | | 习惯 | 语言和称呼、自动更新、使用统计、走动和回应、Coo 能自己改哪些设置、快捷键、显示、声音、电脑操作、OBS 画面 | | 装扮 | 形象、配色和配件，导入或卸载形象包 | | 语音输入 | 识别引擎或转写服务、下载模型、说话键、麦克风、收音方式、说话门槛 | | 系统提示词 | 人设和提示词模板；Ctrl+S 保存，点「立即应用」后当前对话就用上新提示词 | | 用量与成本 | 按日期和模型看 token 用量和花费 | | 对话 | 聊天记录、打字、图片 | | World 扩展 | 已装的 World、分组和排序，扩展市场 | 侧栏底部可以暂停和继续运行，也能切到「高级模式」。高级模式多出「模型供应商」、Persona、Memory、「控制台」和「运行诊断」几页。在「模型供应商」里可以换模型、调推理强度、接入其他兼容的服务、给没有内置价目的服务填价目，也可以装供应商扩展。 设置中的操作错误显示在发起操作的控件旁；控件已离开可视区域时使用底部通知。读取失败留在对应内容区域；刷新失败保留已有数据和编辑内容，重试成功后清除错误。运行诊断分别显示连接、事件和日志错误。头像和名称保存、暂停运行、删除闹钟成功时，由更新后的界面体现结果。 ### World 扩展 在「World 扩展 → 扩展市场」里可以搜索 World，按类别或标签筛选，点卡片上的「添加到我的 World」安装，也可以先点开详情看看。收录在[官方索引](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/cortico-extensions)里的扩展还有标签、投票和评论，评论要登录 GitHub。注意事项标签可以排除，排除后带这个标签的扩展不再出现，下次打开也还记得。 装好的扩展会先出现在「待生效」里，点「重启进程」后生效。在「我的 World」里，你可以： - 给 World 分组、拖动排序，侧栏也按这个顺序排； - 点名字或头像看扩展详情，进入它的配置； - 把 World 从侧栏藏起来，或者让它照常运行、但不让 Coo 看到它的工具和消息，也可以停用、单独重启或删除它。 在 World 设置页，点击标题旁带圆圈的 **i** 即可打开扩展详情。 运行中的 World 不能删除，要先停用。删除的 World 会标红留在「待生效」里，重启进程后才消失。

供应商扩展在「高级模式 → 模型供应商 → 扩展市场」里，还有连接在用的不能删除，要先删掉这些连接。装的扩展都放在数据目录中，重装应用后还在。 安装或卸载扩展时退出应用，会等这次安装或卸载做完再退出。 ### 更新 Windows 安装版和 AppImage 会在后台下载新版本，下好后 Coo 会问你要不要重启更新；选「下次再说」，就等你退出应用时再装。不想自动更新，可以关掉「习惯 → 通用 → 自动更新」，之后不再检查和下载，已经下好的更新也不会装。 Mac 版、deb 和 Windows 便携版不会自动更新。有新版本时，设置窗口的标题栏会出现下载链接，下载后自己安装。 ## 费用与隐私 - **费用**：Coopanion 免费。聊天的费用由你选的模型服务按用量收取，在「用量与成本」页能看到。DeepSeek、OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 付费档和 xAI 有内置价目，金额可以按实时汇率换算成别的币种（取不到汇率时用内置汇率）。登录 ChatGPT 时用的是套餐额度，不显示费用。 - **会发给模型服务的**：你说的话、打的字、附带的图片、你和 Coo 的互动，以及操作电脑时的截图。只发给你配置的那一家。 - **留在你电脑上的**：API Key 和 ChatGPT 的登录状态、记忆、聊天记录、设置和日志。语音在本机识别；当前的模型支持音频输入时，每批语音的录音也会发送给模型服务，录音保存在本机的数据目录，在「语音输入」页可以关闭。如果在「语音输入」页选了转写服务，每句录音会发给那个服务。 - **匿名使用统计**：发到 `survey.palailab.org`，内容是版本号、系统和硬件概况、用的哪家模型、装了哪些扩展、使用次数和时长、设置、程序崩溃时出错的位置，以及一个随机生成的安装编号；不含对话、截图、Key、错误消息和你的文件。每个字段见 [docs/TELEMETRY.md](docs/TELEMETRY.md)。在「习惯 → 通用 → 使用统计」里可以关掉。 - **其他联网**：向 GitHub 查询新版本（Windows 安装版和 AppImage 在启动时和之后每 6 小时查一次，关掉自动更新就不查；其他版本在打开设置窗口时查）；扩展市场访问 npm 和 GitHub 上的官方扩展索引，投票和评论要访问 GitHub；下载语音模型时访问 ModelScope，失败了改用 Hugging Face。 ## 数据与卸载 | 系统 | 数据位置 | 卸载 | | --- | --- | --- | | Windows | 安装目录下的 `data`；便携版是它所在文件夹的 `data` | 在「设置 → 应用」里卸载；便携版先关掉「习惯 → 通用」里的开机启动，再删文件夹 | | macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/Coopanion` | 把「应用程序」里的 Coopanion 拖进废纸篓 | | Linux | `~/.config/Coopanion` | deb：`sudo apt remove coopanion`；AppImage：删掉文件 | 卸载安装版不会删数据。便携版的 `data` 就在它的文件夹里，删文件夹前记得备份。确定不要了，就手动删掉数据目录；Windows 上删整个安装目录，再删掉记录数据位置的 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Coopanion`。数据目录里，`home` 放记忆、聊天记录、设置和 API Key，`home/models` 放语音模型，`extensions` 放扩展，`logs` 放日志。 在 Windows 上重装到新目录后，第一次启动会问你：接着用之前的数据，还是新建一只。 ## 常见问题
桌宠不见了 右键托盘图标，选「显示桌宠」；托盘图标被收起来时，先点任务栏右下角的 `^`。再打开一次程序也行。Mac 上点菜单栏图标，选「显示桌宠」。
点不到 Coo，点击直接穿过了它 托盘菜单里的「鼠标穿透」开着。再点一次把它关掉，或者重启 Coopanion。
Coo 不说话 / 没反应 先看「开始 → 已连接的模型」和侧栏底部的运行状态。显示**已暂停**，点「继续运行」。显示**暂未连接**，检查 API Key 有没有贴全、账户有没有余额，再点「保存并开始」；已经连上的可以点「测试连接」再查一次。通义千问、Kimi、智谱 GLM、MiniMax 的 Key 只能在申请它的平台（国内或国际）上用；豆包要先在方舟控制台开通默认模型。 模型请求连续失败 5 次后，Coo 会在气泡里告诉你出了什么错。Key 被拒或者模型名不对时，气泡上有打开设置的按钮；被限流或服务出错时，它会让你等一会儿再试。
它听不到我说话 - Coo 旁边的麦克风按钮没有被划掉； - 先快速按一下左 Alt，再按住（两下隔得太久不算）； - 「语音输入」页显示识别服务已就绪（提示模型没下载就点「下载」），说话时电平条在跳； - Windows：在「设置 → 隐私和安全性 → 麦克风」里允许桌面应用使用麦克风； - Mac：在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」里给 Coopanion 打开「麦克风」和「输入监控」，改完重启 Coopanion。
需要走代理 Coopanion 用系统代理（HTTP 或 HTTPS 代理，SOCKS 代理不生效），每次请求都按当时的系统设置走，所以开关代理软件不用重启 Coopanion，PAC 脚本也会按网站分别生效。启动 Coopanion 的环境里设了 `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` 时，以环境变量为准。本机内部的通信不走代理。
Linux 上 Coo 走过的地方留下方块残影 用 Intel 核显（Mesa 的 iris 驱动）时，快速清屏会在透明窗口里留下旧画面。启动时设置环境变量 `INTEL_DEBUG=nofc` 把它关掉，比如 deb 版运行 `INTEL_DEBUG=nofc coopanion`；有独立显卡的话，改用独显渲染也能解决。
